anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Isolated reflux-flow dip to 0.024 L/h, followed by recovery at 900 s.
Before the sustained upset: reflux 0.331 L/h, distillate 0.338 L/h, pressure differences 0.980 and 1.989 mbar, system pressure 649.409 mbar.
Abrupt concurrent upset: reflux falls to 0.004 L/h, distillate rises to 1.488 L/h, PDI701 falls to 0.381 mbar, PDI702 rises to 6.896 mbar, and system pressure drops to 392.310 mbar.
Upset persists: reflux 0.006 L/h, distillate 1.286 L/h, pressure differences 0.339 and 6.481 mbar, system pressure 400.862 mbar; both level switches remain 1.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol setpoints and commanded transitions, independent pressure/flow checks, and vacuum, reflux-path and valve status are needed to identify the cause and exclude an intended transition. No composition measurement or separation acceptance criterion is available; temperature readings are unavailable from the manifest.
